nodes.description: External caller address used for ownership, whitelisting and reporter/participant authorization throughout the system.
Chain time; surfaced through controller.getTimestamp() and used to gate reporting, finalization and migration.
IController reference stored in Controlled; used to resolve trusted subsystem addresses via lookup().
Ownable.owner address; controls privileged functions such as transferOwnership, Map.add/remove and emergency withdrawal.
Market finalization marker; non-zero means the market is finalized and drives redemption/finalization logic.
Cached validity bond amount in attoeth held by the market and distributed on finalization.
Map entry counter, incremented on add and decremented on remove without safe arithmetic.
Payable fallback of Delegator that copies calldata and delegatecalls the target resolved from controllerLookupName.
setController guarded by onlyControllerCaller; replaces the controller reference used for all trusted lookups.
Market initialization: validates parameters, sets owner, fee divisor, creates reporters/mailbox/share tokens and refunds surplus msg.value.
Initial report submission gated by endTime, designated-reporter identity and no-show bond distribution.
Dispute contribution that derives the payout hash, creates/uses a dispute crowdsourcer and stakes user funds.
Finalizes a market after the fee window is over, redistributes losing REP and distributes the validity bond.
Finalizes the forking market using the winning child universe payout distribution hash.
Migrates a market to the winning child universe, moving open interest, REP and resetting participants.
onlyInBadTimes/onlyOwner emergency withdrawal that transfers the market's REP and ether balance.
Completes a dispute bond, resets crowdsourcers, forks the universe or migrates participants.
onlyOwner insert into the Map key/value store; increments the entry counter.
onlyOwner removal from the Map key/value store; decrements the entry counter.
onlyOwner ownership transfer that also fires the onTransferOwnership hook.
Escrows shares and denomination tokens for an ask order, pulling balances from the order creator.
Assembly delegatecall in Delegator fallback forwarding raw calldata to a lookup-resolved target.
owner.transfer(_refund) sending surplus msg.value to the market creator address.
msg.sender.transfer(this.balance) external ether send performed at the end of the emergency withdrawal.
count += 1 / count -= 1 arithmetic on the Map entry counter without SafeMath.
Value-bearing external call marketCreatorMailbox.depositEther.value() or cash.depositEtherFor.value() during finalization.
_controller argument of Controlled.setController.
_newOwner argument of Ownable.transferOwnership.
_amount argument of Market.contribute, the REP staked into the dispute crowdsourcer.
_payoutNumerators array of Market.doInitialReport used to derive the payout distribution hash.
_refund local computing msg.value minus the validity bond before returning surplus to the owner.
_repBalance local holding the market's REP balance before the emergency transfer.
_key argument indexing the items mapping in Map.add.

edges.reason: Delegator fallback is publicly callable and forwards caller-supplied calldata to a lookup-resolved target.
onlyControllerCaller gates setController with msg.sender == controller.
Caller supplies msg.value and defines _creator, which becomes owner and receives the refund.
msg.sender is compared to the designated reporter and gates REP staking on the initial report.
contribute stakes REP and dispute tokens on behalf of msg.sender.
withdrawInEmergency is onlyOwner but drains the market balance to msg.sender.
Map.add onlyOwner modifier requires msg.sender == owner.
Map.remove onlyOwner modifier requires msg.sender == owner.
transferOwnership onlyOwner modifier requires msg.sender == owner.
Order escrow pulls shares/tokens from the msg.sender-derived order creator.
require(controller.getTimestamp() < _endTime) makes initialization timestamp dependent.
_timestamp > endTime and designated reporting expiry decide who may submit the initial report.
finalize requires feeWindow.isOver() and writes finalizationTime from controller.getTimestamp().
Migration is only permitted after the forking market is finalized, a time dependent condition.
initialize sets owner = _creator, establishing the privileged account.
initialize computes and refunds surplus msg.value to owner through owner.transfer.
finalize writes winningPayoutDistributionHash from the winning reporting participant.
finalize forwards the validity bond with a .value() external call to mailbox or fee window.
withdrawInEmergency sends the entire ether balance to msg.sender after reading balances.
Map.add increments count with no overflow protection.
Map.remove decrements count with no underflow protection.
Delegator fallback performs delegatecall with attacker-controlled calldata.
delegatecall executes external contract code inside the Delegator storage context.
Value-bearing call to mailbox or cash can re-enter the market during finalization.
Ether transfer to msg.sender is an external call issued from withdrawInEmergency.
_controller argument replaces the trusted controller reference.
_newOwner argument becomes the new privileged owner address.
User-supplied _amount is staked into the dispute crowdsourcer.
_payoutNumerators are validated and hashed into the payout distribution hash.
Computed _refund is the exact value sent to the owner by owner.transfer.
_repBalance is the amount transferred out of the market during emergency withdrawal.
_key indexes the items mapping written by Map.add.

normalization_plan.reason: The controller parameter only exists to be assigned inside setController; folding it into the function removes a transient node.
_newOwner is validated and assigned to owner solely within transferOwnership.
_amount is the sole value forwarded to the dispute crowdsourcer inside contribute.
_payoutNumerators is consumed only for payout hash derivation in doInitialReport.
The _refund local is immediately the operand of the owner.transfer unsafe operation.
The REP balance local is used only for the transfer inside the same withdrawal function.
_key is only used as the mapping index within Map.add.
